# Modelling parity ledger

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/generate-modelling-parity-ledger.mjs — do not edit by hand. Regenerate with `node scripts/generate-modelling-parity-ledger.mjs`; its test fails when this file is stale. -->

The scorecard of the modelling parity hill climb ([#9296](https://github.com/LTplus-AG/ifc-lite/issues/9296)): the capabilities an architect treats as table stakes in Revit, Archicad, Vectorworks and Bonsai, each measured by three probes. Rows, oracles and owners live in `tests/modelling-parity/catalogue.json`; statuses come from the probes' result files, scored by `tests/modelling-parity/score.mjs`.

**Table-stakes score: 23 / 25** (met 21, partial 4, missing 0). A met row counts 1, a partial row 0.5. The score may only go up: `node tests/modelling-parity/score.mjs <dirs> --check tests/modelling-parity/baseline/r2-combined.json` fails when it or any row drops.

**Per-level passes: SDK 20/25 · UI 21/25 · OUTPUT 23/25.** Non-applicable levels earn no pass.

Summary: `tests/modelling-parity/baseline/r2-combined.json`, generated 2026-11-13T03:21:42.545Z from 6818 results on `a7a16a70b2`; inputs `tests/modelling-parity/.out/r2-sdk`, `tests/modelling-parity/.out/r2-exercises`, `tests/modelling-parity/.out/r2-ui-probes`, `tests/modelling-parity/.out/r2-ui-exercises`.

Levels:

- **SDK**: a headless script on a blank model through `bim.store` / `@ifc-lite/create`, checked against a geometry or data oracle read back from the exported, meshed IFC (`tests/modelling-parity/probes/sdk/`).
- **UI**: the same capability in the Model workspace on the real GPU via `ifc-gpu-check` (`tests/modelling-parity/ui/`).
- **Output**: the SDK probe's IFC4 export, and any IFC a UI result hands over, through `ifc-lite validate`, a reopen round trip and IfcOpenShell validate with express rules (`tests/modelling-parity/output/`). Drawing files a UI result hands over (SVG, PDF, DXF, for the documentation rows) get parse, non-empty and linework/page checks. Sheet DXF additionally gets independent ezdxf checks for closed rectangular wall boundaries, named layers, dimension linework and text, metre units and the known 104 mm span at 1:50. Other drawing checks remain sanity checks, not geometric reference comparisons.
- **Exercise**: the best result of the F1–F6 exercises that exercise the row (reported, not scored).

✅ pass · ◐ partial · ❌ fail or error · – skipped, not run, or not applicable. A row is **met** when every applicable level passes, **partial** when any level passes or partly passes, **missing** otherwise; `skip` never counts as a pass.
